verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat and the MCP server explicitly enable natural-language Q&A across meeting history ('what did we decide about pricing?'-style queries), searching transcripts across all time periods and analyzing patterns across multiple meetings, with sourced context tied back to specific meetings/transcripts. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of answer accuracy/source citation quality and no community corroboration of the chat/search feature specifically (only recording/privacy feedback exists).
